description: Classification of product, donor and legacy identity in tracked files (N0.1), and the independence gate (N0.9). Rules are ordered: the first rule whose path, term and line patterns all match classifies a finding. Every rule has a reason; every rule but the last has at least one constraint. The census tool, this policy, its test and the census artifact are not scanned: they must name every term.

categories.ACTIVE_PRODUCT_IDENTITY: Product-facing name or copy; changes to Ninerr.
categories.ACTIVE_INTERNAL_IDENTITY: Internal identifier, comment or donor attribution in active code; changes or is removed.
categories.PUBLIC_API: Identifier a user, agent or integration addresses; migrates with a transition path.
categories.PERSISTED_DATA: Identity written to disk; needs a versioned migration and a legacy reader.
categories.LEGACY_COMPATIBILITY: Recognizes legacy identity so existing data keeps working; transitional, never written for new data.
categories.TEST_FIXTURE: Test or fixture content; updates with the code it tests.
categories.THIRD_PARTY_INDEPENDENT_OBLIGATION: Names an independently licensed dependency or runtime whose license obligations Ninerr keeps.
categories.IMMUTABLE_HISTORICAL_FACT: A dated record of what happened; not rewritten.
categories.REMOVE_ENTIRELY: Retired material with no role in Ninerr; removed from the tree (history keeps it).
